scenarios.name: retail_fresh_chain_down_then_up
scenarios.description: Fresh retail stack from ORIGINAL1: settle, hold DOWN through every open level (locked rows skipped) until no target remains, then tap UP once and let it stop.

scenarios.name: small_glow_cycle_and_tints
scenarios.description: Synthetic stack: completed, open, locked, inaccessible and other-theme open rows; idle long enough for two glow cycles; BACK is ignored after the first play.

scenarios.name: small_down_wins_and_release
scenarios.description: Hold DOWN and UP together (DOWN wins), release mid-leg (STOPPING then snap), re-press during STOPPING (ignored), hold DOWN past the locked world to the last open row, then hold UP back to the top.

scenarios.name: small_info_back_play_fade
scenarios.description: GO before the box is fully out (ignored), GO when out: spin out and hold; GO during the spin (ignored); BACK spins in; GO again, GO on hold croaks and fades into the game.

scenarios.name: small_back_first_time
scenarios.description: First visit: BACK while moving is ignored; BACK once stationary leaves for the main menu.
